invariants.text: Book.isbn must be unique across all Book entities
Book.available_copies must be a non-negative integer
Book.author_id must reference an existing Author entity
Author.id must be unique across all Author entities
Member.email must be unique across all Member entities
Loan.book_id must reference an existing Book entity
Loan.member_id must reference an existing Member entity
Loan.return_date must be null if Loan.status is 'active'
Loan.return_date must be after Loan.due_date if Loan.status is 'returned'
Loan.return_date must be null if Loan.status is 'overdue'
Book.available_copies must not exceed the total copies added for that book
Member.membership_date must be a valid date (not in the future)
